concerns.text: T012 (Filtering) is listed as a dependency for T013-EXPLICIT (Merge), but T012's logic explicitly requires the merged dataset as input ('Merge datasets on subject_id'). This creates a circular dependency: T013 needs T012 to filter, but T012 needs T013 to merge. The merge must precede filtering to allow row-wise exclusion of nulls.

T014b (Dynamic Sampling) is triggered AFTER T015 (Sample Size Validation Gate). T015 checks N >= 50 on the full dataset. If the full dataset is too large for memory, T015 will likely crash or T014b will be triggered too late. Sampling (T014b) must occur BEFORE the final validation gate (T015) to ensure the dataset passed to T015 is already memory-safe and N >= 50.

T020c (Shannon Diversity) depends on T020a (CLR) and T021 (Log-Transform). However, T020c's input is listed as 'cleared_default.csv' (from T020a) and 'merged_complete.csv' (from T013). T021 produces 'cleared_with_diversity.csv' which merges the log-transformed titers. T020c should depend on T021 to ensure the output file contains both CLR taxa and log-titers, rather than relying on a partial merge from T013.

T034d (Threshold Sweep) depends on T034b (Permutation Baseline). T034d's logic requires re-running the null distribution generation for *each* threshold. T034b generates a *single* global null distribution. The dependency implies T034d uses the static output of T034b, violating the plan's requirement to regenerate the null distribution per threshold. T034d must contain the logic to generate its own null distributions or depend on a task that does so per-threshold.

T011b (Strategy B - Download) is marked as a dependency of T011c, but T011b is conditional on T011a failure. The task list structure implies a linear flow. While the text notes the condition, the explicit dependency chain T011a -> T011b -> T011c is semantically broken if T011a succeeds. The ordering should reflect that T011b-T011d are a separate branch or T011c/d depend on the *output* of the ingestion phase regardless of the strategy used.

T008b (Load .env) depends on T008a (Create .env). T008a is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but creates a file. T008b reads it. While logically sequential, the [P] tag on T008a is misleading if it implies it can run in parallel with T008b. T008a should not be [P] if it is a strict prerequisite for T008b in the same execution context.
